messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "pain severe enough to require opioids"
set: ["pain severe enough to require opioids", "moderate to moderately severe pain", "severe stomach pain", "severe sinus pain", "severe chest pain", "moderate to severe pain in adults", "allergy to other opioids", "other opioids", "non-opioid pain medicines do not treat pain well enough", "moderate to moderately severe pain in adults", "other pain treatments do not treat your pain well enough", "severe pain in upper stomach", "severe stomach pain or vomiting", "moderate to moderately severe chronic pain in adults", "around-the-clock treatment of moderate to moderately severe chronic pain", "severe stomach pain may indicate pancreatitis"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
